snippet.title: 9 Lives To Escape Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Prepare for a pixel-perfect challenge!
In this hardcore platformer, you have just 9 lives to survive a deadly gauntlet of traps and hazards. Jump, run, and restart — again and again — until you master each level.

🔸 Tight platforming
🔸 Deadly spike traps, saws, arrows and more
🔸 9 chances per level – no room for mistakes
🔸 Retro pixel art style and arcade challenge

How far can you go before your 9 lives run out?

✨Play now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725960/9_Lives_To_Escape/

#9LivesToEscape #LapaGames #IndieGame #SteamGame #PixelArt #Platformer
